lead.headline: Navy and Boston University open 4-1
lead.deck: The Terriers rate highest in the league at 183rd. The Midshipmen have won four straight.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the Patriot League, ten schools from Boston, Worcester and Hamilton through Lewisburg, Bethlehem and Easton to West Point, Annapolis, Baltimore and Washington. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
Boston University (183rd) beat Northeastern 93-85, won 72-67 at Brown and beat Dartmouth 90-75. Its loss came 72-55 at Northwestern.
Navy lost 91-39 at George Washington in its opener, then won four in a row, including 81-76 over Penn and 58-56 over Hampton.
American (193rd) won 66-64 at Drexel and beat Harvard 70-64.

column.label: By the Numbers
column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **3.** Patriot teams still winless: Bucknell, Colgate and Holy Cross, a combined 0-11.
**118.** Army's points against the Mount St. Mary Knights, the league's high.
**2.** Patriot teams in our national top 200, Boston University and American.

notes.headline: Lehigh holds home court
notes.body: The Mountain Hawks beat Cornell 71-64 and Marist 65-60 at home, and lost 65-55 to Brown.

notes.headline: Loyola's overtime loss
notes.body: The Greyhounds lost 63-61 in overtime to Morgan State.

notes.headline: Lafayette's long night
notes.body: The Leopards lost 67-57 in overtime at Saint Joseph's.

notes.headline: One bid
notes.body: The Patriot League tournament in March decides the league's NCAA bid.
